basic_info.description: This top-floor retreat has been meticulously renovated and offers 2 bedrooms and 1.5 baths. With a private elevator from the street and stunning views from the spacious new chef's kitchen equipped with quartz countertops and new appliances, this home is designed for seamless hosting. Adjacent, a dining room and separate living area await, accompanied by the convenience of a recently constructed in-unit laundry facility and a new half bathroom. The spa-like full bathroom features a newly built custom and curbless rain shower and a free-standing tub. Enjoy panoramic views of Sutro Tower and Twin Peaks from the shared rooftop garden deck, an idyllic setting for entertaining under the open sky. This unit includes 1-car parking and a large storage unit. The building recently underwent a series of permitted structural and electrical upgrades. Conveniently located, 1180A De Haro is moments away from abundant dining options with easy access to freeways and public transportation.
